Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned AGA for the State as well as perused.
Applicant- Ms. Saroj is the erstwhile wife of Lavkush- opposite party No.2.
Opposite party No.2 to 6 are charge-sheeted accused of Case Crime No.37 of 2022 under Section 498A, 323, 504, 506, 494 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Haliyapur, District- Sultanpur.
Submission advanced by learned counsel for the applicant is that the Case Crime No.37 of 2022 is pending since 03.09.2022 and the trial is proceeding with snail's speed.
It is contended by learned counsel for the applicant that the poor lady is running from the pillar to post but of no avail.
